title: Arquiteto de soluções, financial industry brazil em são paulo (RN)
description:
Você está em busca de uma carreira com grandes desafios? É curioso e persistente? Você quer se desenvolver em um ambiente inovador, onde experimentamos coisas novas e sonhamos grande? Quer fazer parte do futuro da computação em nuvem com uma equipe obcecada por ajudar os clientes?Se sim, junte-se à nossa equipe AWS no Brasil como Arquiteto de Soluções e ajude nossos clientes a mudarem o mundo! A AWS é a plataforma de nuvem mais adotada e mais abrangente do mundo, suportando milhões de clientes, incluindo startups, grandes empresas e órgãos governamentais.Nesta função, sua criatividade conectará tecnologia a soluções tangíveis. Você trabalhará todos os dias para ajudar os clientes a aproveitar ao máximo os serviços da AWS, para que possam inovar, prosperar e transformar nosso país. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender novas habilidades e aprimorar as suas existentes. Você criará e compartilhará conteúdo técnico, arquiteturas de referência e práticas recomendadas. Você divulgará e educará sobre a tecnologia da AWS.Esperamos de você motivação, trabalho em colaboração com pessoas ao redor do mundo, disposição para enfrentar desafios, paixão pelo que faz e se divertir ao fazê-lo. Você deve gostar de treinar, desenhar e criar soluções em nuvem para um conjunto diversificado e desafiador de clientes.Key job responsibilitiesOs arquitetos de soluções têm 4 responsabilidades principais:1. Atuar de forma consultiva com clientes. Em parceria com a equipe de contas, formular e executar uma estratégia para viabilizar o sucesso do cliente. Ajudar os clientes a adotar os serviços da AWS e fazer o melhor uso deles, gerando receita como resultado. Educar os clientes sobre a proposta de valor da AWS e participar de discussões de arquitetura para garantir que as soluções sejam desenhadas para uma implantação bem-sucedida na nuvem. Criar confiança com indivíduos técnicos dentro dos clientes para que sejam cloud advocates.2. Ser referência técnica. Transferir conhecimento para clientes. Capturar e compartilhar conhecimento e boas práticas na comunidade de arquitetura de soluções da AWS. Contribuir com publicações para o cliente da AWS, como whitepapers, postagens ou blogs. Apresentar e contribuir em workshops, grupos de usuários, vídeos online e conferências.3. Estar em crescimento profissional contínuo. Ser curiosa e se manter aprendendo. Demonstrar seu aprendizado através das Certificações da AWS. Trabalhar com outras pessoas para ajudá-las a entregar mais. Participar de encontros e conferências.4. Desenvolver e executar melhorias organizacionais. Atuar como um elo técnico entre os clientes e as equipes de engenharia de serviços para melhorar os serviços e recursos da AWS. Contribuir com suas ideias para inovação para times internos e clientes. Simplificar processos que podem ser simplificados. Ajudar a contratar e desenvolver talentos.About the teamA Amazon Web Services Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DE&I) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos.Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos comprometidos em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos 13 employee led groups globalmente, que reúnem os funcionários da Amazon entre organizações e países ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, alguns exemplos incluem o , o Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e o Black Employee Network (BEN). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram as pessoas a buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender, ter curiosidade e ganhar confiança.Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador(a) e ele(a) o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.Mentoria e Crescimento profissionalNossa equipe é dedicada a apoiar as pessoas recém contratadas. Temos uma equipe com ampla variedade de níveis de experiência e cargos, e estamos construindo um ambiente que celebra o compartilhamento de conhecimento e a mentoria. Nós nos preocupamos com o crescimento de sua carreira e nos esforçamos para atribuir projetos que contribuam para que cada pessoa da equipe se desenvolva e possa liderar iniciativas mais complexas no futuro.A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferidas listadas na descrição da vaga, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.Por que AWS?A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.Cultura de Equipe InclusivaAqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curioso. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos capacita a ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos contínuos e experiências de aprendizado, incluindo nossas Conversas sobre Raça e Etnia (CORE) e conferências sobre diversidade, nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.Mentoria e Crescimento ProfissionalEstamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento infinito de conhecimento, mentoria e outros recursos para desenvolvimento de carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida PessoalValorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir à custa de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar na nuvem.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - + 8 anos de experiência em áreas específicas de tecnologia (por exemplo, desenvolvimento de software, computação em nuvem, engenharia de sistemas, infraestrutura, segurança, redes, dados e análises)- +6 anos de experiência em design, implementação ou consultoria em aplicações e infraestruturas- Experiência em desenvolvimento de TI ou implementação/consultoria nas indústrias de software ou internet- Habilidade de comunicação efetiva em inglês (escrita e oral)
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experiência em vendas, pré-vendas ou consultoria de tecnologia/software- Experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou em setores relacionados à internet- Experiência em migração ou transformação de soluções legadas de clientes para a nuvem- Experiência com tecnologias AWS

title: Operador de estacionamento hab. em são paulo (RN)
description:
QUE TAL TRABALHAR EM UMA EMPRESA A SERVIÇO DAS CIDADES INTELIGENTES DO AMANHÃ?
A INDIGO é líder mundial em gestão de estacionamentos e mobilidade individual. Estamos em mais de 500 cidades de 10 países. No Brasil, são mais de 370 operações em 97 cidades de 24 estados + DF.
Sabe como a gente faz tudo isso acontecer?
Ao redor do mundo, contamos com mais de 9 mil colaboradores – dos quais 4.700 são brasileiros. Todos eles atuam no gerenciamento de soluções personalizadas e cada vez mais inteligentes, que viabilizam uma jornada tranquila e integrada para o cliente.
Uma das prioridades da INDIGO é ouvir seus funcionários e garantir que eles tenham carreiras bem-sucedidas. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos e na criação de políticas de desenvolvimento. Além disso, nos esforçamos para fomentar a igualdade de gênero, promover oportunidades iguais e combater a discriminação. Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho onde todos se sintam realizados, motivados e engajados.
Mais propósito, menos impacto, mais Indigo
Estamos transformando nossos estacionamentos em hubs de serviço úteis e sustentáveis que formam elos cruciais na corrente de mobilidade urbana. Sem estacionamento, não há mobilidade, e, sem mobilidade, não há desenvolvimento. Porém, esse desenvolvimento precisa estar de acordo com o desejo das pessoas: menos estresse, ruídos, poluição e trânsito. 
Por isso, “criar espaços para uma cidade tranquila em movimento”  é o que fazemos na Indigo. Esse é o nosso propósito. É para isso que trabalhamos diariamente.
Vamos juntos construir esse futuro?
#VEMPRAINDIGO  /nO que estamos procurando:

Ensino Médio Completo;
CNH válida (obrigatória);
Realização de manobras. /nResponsabilidades e desafios

Realização de manobras;
Registrar de imediato todo e qualquer veículo que entre no estacionamento;
Verificar se os clientes são credenciados, mensalistas ou condôminos e checar que o cliente possui a credencial de identificação;
Ao recepcionar o cliente na entrada, entregar o cartão com o número do prisma e informar para o mesmo o local exclusivo para pagamento e retirada do veículo;
Informar ao cliente sobre procedimentos e normas do estacionamento, envolvendo tolerâncias, valores, localização e outras informações pertinentes, focando sempre na boa recepção dos usuários;
Manter as chaves dos veículos corretamente alocadas em claviculários e garantir a identificação do veículo por meio da fixação de prisma numerado;
Visando a segurança do veículo, deve-se manter vidros e portas sempre fechados;
Respeitar o limite de velocidade máxima no local.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Program Manager to join the Transportation Excellence team, leading the strategy and execution of transformational customer experience initiatives and long-term innovation programs. In this role, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of strategic CX initiatives that redefine how Amazon delivers excellence across transportation networks, from concept development through scaled implementation and sustained impact measurement.This role requires someone who can identify emerging customer needs before they become visible in metrics, architect multi-year roadmaps that balance innovation with operational reality, and drive organizational alignment across Transportation, Operations, Product, and Technology teams to deliver breakthrough customer experiences. You will define the vision for next-generation delivery excellence, lead the incubation of new capabilities, and build mechanisms that enable continuous innovation while maintaining operational discipline.The ideal candidate demonstrates Amazon's Leadership Principles, particularly Customer Obsession, Think Big, Invent and Simplify, Deliver Results, and Earn Trust. You should excel at translating ambiguous customer problems into concrete solutions, support influencing senior leadership to invest in long-term initiatives, navigating trade-offs between innovation and execution, and building coalitions across organizations to drive transformational change.At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated workers thrive and where workers ownership leads to meaningful results. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you'll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.Key job responsibilities• Manage the roadmap for customer experience innovation in transportation, identifying emerging trends and customer needs that will shape delivery excellence over multi-year horizons.• Lead the development and incubation of new initiatives from concept through pilot to scaled deployment, establishing success criteria, measurement frameworks, and governance mechanisms that enable disciplined innovation.• Drive cross-organizational alignment on long-term CX priorities, influencing leadership across Transportation, Operations, Product, and Technology to secure investment and organizational commitment for transformational programs. • Design and implement mechanisms that connect and capture customer feedback with CX team, translate insights into actionable initiatives, and measure the impact of CX improvements on customer satisfaction and business outcomes.• Lead complex trade-off analyses between customer experience enhancements and operational constraints, developing business cases that quantify customer impact, operational feasibility, and financial implications. • Build and scale best practices for CX-driven innovation across the transportation network, creating frameworks that enable teams to experiment, learn, and iterate while maintaining operational excellence.• Communicate compelling narratives to executive leadership that articulate the customer problem, proposed solution, expected impact, and progress against milestones, securing ongoing support for long-term strategic initiatives.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLook Ups) at an advanced level and SQL- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements- Program or project management experience- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams- Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience- Supply chain experience- Bachelor's degree- Intermediate English knowledge
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership- Experience driving process improvements- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
company: Amazon Servicos De Varejo Do Brasil Ltda.

title: Business intelligence engineer, br trans execution, trans execution, amzl bra em são paulo (RN)
description:
Are you excited about uncovering actionable insights to improve delivery experience? Do you get excited about operating in an ambiguous and fast-moving environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to define analytics roadmap, work with cross-functional teams, experiment with AWS tech solutions, and build decision-driven analytics solutions for work that is critical to Amazon's continued ability to deliver smiles in communities?We are looking for an innovative and highly-motivated Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) who can think holistically about problems to understand how systems work together to identify and execute both tactical and strategic projects. You will work closely with engineering teams, product managers, program managers, and org leaders to deliver end-to-end data solutions aimed at continuously enhancing overall delivery operations and Trans Execution BR performance.Key job responsibilitiesYou will have an opportunity to lead medium to large-scale projects along with owning multiple domains within the team and contributing to the analytics roadmap. You will be instrumental in transforming manual processes into automated, scalable solutions that support scheduling, capacity management, and operational excellence across all delivery channels in Brazil.- Earn the trust of your customers and stakeholders by continuing to constantly obsess over their business use cases and data needs, and helping them solve their problems by leveraging technology.- Work closely with business stakeholders and leadership team to review roadmap and contributing to business strategy and how they can leverage - Manage and execute entire projects from start to finish including stakeholder management, data gathering and manipulation, modeling, problem solving, and communication of insights and recommendations.- Extract, transform, and load data from many data sources using SQL, Scripting and other ETL tools.- Design, build, and maintain automated reporting, dashboards, and ongoing analysis to enable data driven decisions across our team and with partner teams.- Report key insight trends using statistical rigor to simplify and inform the larger team of noteworthy trends that impact the business.- Retrieve and analyze data using a broad set of Amazon’s data technologies (ex. Redshift, AWS S3, Amazon Internal Platforms/Solutions) and resources, knowing how, when, and which to use.About the teamThe Trans Execution BR team at AMZL Brazil is a newly established, high-impact function responsible for the end-to-end management of Brazil's delivery network. Our scope encompasses capacity planning, demand forecasting, scheduling and route optimization, and risk management across all delivery channels. We are building this team from the ground up, with a mission to transform a highly manual, Excel-driven process into a scalable, automated, and data-driven operation that serves the full spectrum of Amazon's delivery models in Brazil.We operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where operational rigor and innovative thinking go hand in hand. We are part of a global community of Trans Execution teams, with counterparts in Japan, India, and other geographies, and we actively collaborate across borders to share best practices and co-develop technology solutions. Our team is growing rapidly, and we are looking for people who are excited to build something new, solve hard problems, and make a measurable impact on Amazon's delivery network in Brazil.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, Quick Sight, Micro Strategy, Power BI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, No SQL etc.- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

title: Regional linehaul operations manager, amazon transportation services em cabo de santo agostinho (PE)
description:
Amazon Transportation Services is looking for a Regional Operations Linehaul Manager to join our ATS Middle Mile Ground Brazil team. This is a senior, high-complexity position that requires experienced leadership to manage middle mile linehaul operations across a region.In this role, you will lead and optimize linehaul operations at a regional level, ensuring operational excellence across the full middle mile transportation process. Unlike a single-carrier or station-focused role, this position is cross-functional and regional — you will work across all carriers and programs in your region, acting as the bridge between central strategy and local execution.You will be part of a highly collaborative, dynamic, and innovative environment where ideas are valued and experimentation is encouraged. We are looking for professionals with a strong track record of operational excellence and customer focus, who thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and are ready to lead through complexity and constant change.If you enjoy challenges and are ready to deliver results in an environment that combines the energy of a start-up with the scale of a global company, we want to meet you.KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES-- Regional Operations & Performance Management --•Lead regional linehaul operations cross-functionally across all carriers and programs in the region• Manage performance of multiple carriers, ensuring achievement of OTP (On-Time Pickup) and OTA (On-Time Arrival) targets• Conduct daily and weekly operational reviews, leading calls with operational teams and developing action plans for continuous improvement• Perform Gemba walks and on-road monitoring to identify process gaps and implement corrective actions • Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to other operational departments-- Carrier Management & Development --• Coordinate onboarding, training and ramp-up of new carriers in the region, including supporting on-site audits• Implement and scale the Amazon Excellence Program with regional carriers• Develop strategic relationships with carriers, serving as primary point of contact for performance and problem resolution regionally/locally-- Operational Excellence & Cost Management --• Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Kaizen methodologies• Identify optimization opportunities and implement solutions to improve operational efficiency• Contribute to cost reduction initiatives through identification of regional optimization opportunities• Support regional implementation of network optimization and routing efficiency initiatives-- Collaboration & Leadership --• Collaborate with central and represent regional operations in business reviews, act as bridge between central strategy and regional execution• Serve as voice of carriers within regional operations
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays- Experience in employee and performance management- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering- Experience in operational logistics/supply chain, manufacturing, transportation, general management or an engineering role- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders- Experience developing operational metrics- Demonstrated experience managing multiple carriers or suppliers simultaneously- Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing- Knowledge of process improvement, ideally including Lean, Kaizen and Six Sigma- Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python- Experience with an e-commerce company- Experience in Transportation Law

title: Enterprise controls build lead em são paulo (RN)
description:
As a fast growing Fintech in the LATAM region, we are looking for a highly capable Manager/Lead, Internal Controls to lead the design and build of our control environment across the company. This role is ideal for someone who is both strategic and hands-on: a builder who can independently assess processes, map risks, design pragmatic controls, develop SOPs, and drive cross-functional adoption in a fast-moving environment.
This person will play a critical role in helping the company mature its operating model by reducing operational risk, improving consistency and accountability, and ensuring scalable controls are embedded into day-to-day execution. The right candidate will know how to influence stakeholders across functions, move fluidly from ambiguity to structure, and build fit-for-purpose controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and build of the company’s enterprise control framework across key business and operational processes
Assess existing workflows and identify control gaps, failure points, manual dependencies, and areas of elevated operational risk
Map end-to-end processes and translate them into clear, scalable control points and operating procedures
Design preventive, detective, and monitoring controls that are practical, auditable, and aligned with business realities
Develop and formalize SOPs, control documentation, ownership structures, escalation paths, and remediation processes
Partner across Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and Data teams to embed controls into daily operations and system workflows
Drive control implementation from concept through rollout, including stakeholder alignment, documentation, training, and follow-up
Establish governance around control execution, issue tracking, remediation, and evidence retention
Bring structure and discipline to how control failures are identified, escalated, root-caused, remediated, and closed
Apply a strong understanding of risk and control principles, including COSO-based thinking, to create a coherent and scalable controls environment
Operate independently with high ownership in an environment that is still building maturity, process discipline, and organizational muscle
Support management readiness for internal audit, external review, board-level discussions, or broader control maturity initiatives as needed Requirements What We’re Looking For
6–10+ years of experience in enterprise controls, operational risk, internal controls, internal audit, process excellence, or a related field
Strong experience building or significantly upgrading controls in a high-growth company, fintech, startup, or similarly dynamic environment
Deep expertise in process mapping, SOP development, controls design, remediation tracking, and operating model improvement
Strong understanding of internal control frameworks such as COSO
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives with limited structure
Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive action across business, product, and technical teams
Comfortable being both strategic and hands-on: this is a builder role, not a purely advisory role
Strong judgment in balancing rigor and practicality; able to create effective controls without slowing down the business unnecessarily
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear actions and documentation
Experience in regulated environments, lending, fintech, payments, or financial services is strongly preferred
Experience in startup scaling, operational excellence, or transformation work is a strong plus What We Offer
The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech with regional scale.
Leadership over enterprise controls for a fast paced and growth oriented startup.
Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams across Latin America.
Exposure to complex legal and regulatory challenges and innovation in embedded finance. Locations: BR, AR, CO, MX

title: Manager, ai services consulting em são paulo (RN)
description:
Job Description Why This Role? Why Now?
Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change — we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionizing how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the Manager, you will be leading a team of consultants who deliver quick time to value while guiding their customers through technical configuration and optimization. This role blends deep product expertise with people leadership: you’ll be both the product authority for your team and the coach who develops their skills to deliver at scale.
Mission
You will manage and grow a high-performing team (6–10 direct reports) that consistently delivers fast, measurable customer outcomes on Zendesk AI. You will set clear strategy, standards, and operating rhythm for AI delivery, ensuring the right people are staffed to the right work, projects are tightly scoped and executed predictably, and risks/blockers are escalated and removed quickly. You will align with Sales, Customer Success, and Product on customer roadmaps and success metrics. You will be responsible for continuous improvement in methodology, enablement, and quality so we increase adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion at scale.
Overarching Objective For The Role: 
Scale a high-performing AI Delivery organization: Hire, onboard, coach, and retain AI Services Consultants; build clear roles, capacity planning, and career development.
Deliver predictable, measurable customer outcomes and time to value: Ensure projects are staffed and executed on time and within scope with clear success metrics tied to business impact. Proactively manage risks, technical blockers, and stakeholder alignment to keep implementations moving and value realized through scale.
Drive cross-functional alignment and a repeatable AI delivery motion: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to align on customer AI roadmaps, handoffs, and expansion paths. Use customer insights and delivery data to improve packaging, playbooks, and forecasting—supporting retention and growth.
How You’ll Make an Impact Strategic Responsibilities
Build and scale the AI Delivery operating model: Define and evolve the delivery methodology, standards, templates, and governance to ensure consistent quality and repeatability across customers and consultants.
Own capacity, prioritization, and staffing strategy: Forecast demand, balance utilization vs. customer outcomes, assign the right consultants to the right work, and proactively manage escalations and tradeoffs to protect time-to-value and margin.
Drive outcome-based execution and accountability: Ensure your team delivers high quality solutions, delivery meets timelines, scope, and measurable business impact based on the AI Success Roadmap.
Lead cross-functional alignment for a unified AI go-to-customer motion: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Product on handoffs, customer AI roadmaps, risk management, and expansion plays, creating shared accountability for retention and growth.
Develop team capability and product authority at scale: Coach and enable a team of 6–10 consultants through skills development, knowledge management, and technical/product readiness; create feedback loops from the field to improve product, tooling, and enablement.
What You’ll Need to Succeed Strategic Skills & Expertise
People leadership & team scaling: Proven ability to hire, onboard, coach, and retain consultants; set clear expectations, drive performance, and build career paths and progression frameworks.
Technical and product authority in AI implementations: Strong fluency in AI-enabled customer service workflows, integrations, data readiness, and configuration best practices—able to guide solution design decisions and unblock complex escalations.
Operational delivery: Define and run team playbooks, KPIs, and SLAs; own tooling or dashboards that provide a single source of truth for delivery and risk.
Delivery management excellence: Expertise in running multi-workstream delivery with strong scoping, resourcing, risk management, change control, and executive stakeholder communication to ensure predictable outcomes.
Outcome-based consulting & value realization: Skilled at translating customer goals and roadmaps into technical solutions, defining scope and timelines, and delivering quality implementations. 
Cross-functional influence & GTM alignment: Ability to align Sales, CS, Product, and Services on customer roadmaps, handoffs, and expansion motions; leverage delivery insights to improve packaging, forecasting, and product feedback loops.
Qualifications 7+ years in Professional Services / Technical

title: Ai platform engineer id60187 em belo horizonte (RN)
description:
Agile Engine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to sit at the center of how our engineering organization works with AI — spanning tooling support, an internal agentic SDLC platform, and product incubation. You will work closely with the AI Enablement Lead, Director of Engineering, and product leadership to translate internal AI workflows into features we ship to customers.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Own the day-to-day configuration and optimization of AI coding and productivity tools;
- Act as the primary point of contact for engineers, triaging and resolving issues like integration failures, model compatibility, or configuration drift;
- Maintain onboarding documentation and runbooks to ensure engineers of all levels can use AI effectively;
- Run enablement sessions and office hours to drive adoption and guide engineers on best practices for AI-assisted development;
- Gather feedback from teams to translate real usage patterns into continuous improvements for workflows and tooling;
- Drive the refinement and expansion of an internal agentic pipeline that connects specification, implementation, testing, and validation into a coherent automated workflow;
- Own the integration layer between AI agents and the development toolchain, including third-party integrations, execution environments, and context injection strategies;
- Advance specification quality by building tooling, templates, and workflows that help engineers write specs that agents can act on reliably;
- Design and run experiments to validate agent configuration decisions and translate findings into platform improvements;
- Evaluate emerging tools and platforms for potential integration into the agentic workflow;
- Serve as the primary internal test bed for AI-powered features and workflows intended to ship to external customers;
- Collaborate with product and engineering leadership to translate internal learnings into product insights and roadmap inputs;
- Prototype AI-assisted developer experiences that can graduate into product features for Saa S customers;
- Maintain a rigorous dogfood culture by using products internally and bringing insights back into the development process.
MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of experience in a software engineering, Dev Ops, or platform engineering role with any backend language such as PHP, Java, Type Script, Java Script, Python, C#,. NET, or Golang ;
- 1+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-based tools or agentic workflows in a professional setting;
- Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Windsurf, Amp, or Cursor ;
- Comfort working across multiple technologies and a mixed-technical environment;
- Direct experience deploying and supporting AI coding assistants across a large engineering team, including configuration, rollout, and troubleshooting;
- Ability to understand complex engineering problems and design practical, scalable solutions;
- Familiarity with LLM infrastructure concepts including model routing, API proxying, token management, and model versioning ;
- Strong written communication skills ;
- Comfort working with engineers at varying AI maturity levels;
- Experience working with automated testing toolchains in a CI/CD context;
- Upper-intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with PHP and/or C# environments;
- Hands-on experience building or operating agentic AI workflows, including multi-step agent pipelines and tool/API integration;
- Experience with spec-driven or structured software specification methodologies;
- Background in Saa S product development;
- Experience in a developer tools, testing tools, or security software company;
- Experience working in distributed teams across multiple time zones.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, Tech Talks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) está buscando profissionais de gestão técnica experientes e motivados para orientar, desenvolver e trabalhar em parceria com profissionais de Arquitetura de Soluções tecnicamente qualificados e obcecados pelo cliente. Em colaboração com vendas, você impulsionará o crescimento dos clientes. Além disso, liderança estratégica em termos de olhar além da tecnologia e considerar o valor que a tecnologia cria para nossos clientes, são aspectos importantes da função. Você ajudará membros da equipe a se desenvolverem na AWS, bem como desenvolver habilidades de comunicação, escrita, apresentação e interação executiva. Você também precisará ser hábil em interagir, comunicar e fazer parcerias com outras equipes dentro da AWS, como equipes de serviços, marketing e serviços profissionais, além de representar sua equipe para a liderança da empresa.A posição de gestão em Arquitetura de Soluções liderará uma equipe que apoia clientes altamente avançados no negócio digital, incluindo empresas de alta tecnologia.Aqui estão algumas outras qualidades que estamos procurando:**Colaborativo e engajador** - Você é dinâmico, criativo e pronto para enfrentar desafios para causar um impacto significativo? Na AWS, temos um credo de "Trabalhe duro. Divirta-se. Faça história." Nesta função, você deve ser apaixonado pelo seu trabalho e saber como criar um ambiente de trabalho envolvente.**Apaixonado pelo desenvolvimento de pessoas** - Você tem paixão por treinar e capacitar especialistas em soluções para apoiar um conjunto diverso e desafiador de clientes? Uma das missões é desenvolver talentos técnicos para alcançar os objetivos dos clientes, da AWS e equipe.**Obcecado por clientes** - A missão da Amazon é ser a empresa mais centrada no cliente do mundo, e você deve ser capaz de mergulhar profundamente para ajudar sua equipe a entender as necessidades dos clientes.**Experiência em pensamento arquitetural** - Forte compreensão de soluções de computação em larga escala e arquiteturas inovadoras. A pessoa ideal tem experiência trabalhando como Arquiteto de Soluções ou em função similar e gerenciando uma equipe de profissionais de Arquitetura de Soluções. Você gostará de manter suas habilidades técnicas existentes e desenvolver novas, permitindo que você faça contribuições fortes para discussões de arquitetura.**Produtividade e eficiência** - Experiência no uso de Gen AI e IA para impulsionar produtividade e inovação. A pessoa ideal sabe como aplicar essas tecnologias para automatizar tarefas repetitivas e liberar a equipe para focar no que realmente faz a diferença: entregar valor excepcional para o cliente. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar pelo exemplo, mostrando como a IA pode transformar a forma como trabalhamos e nos relacionamos com os clientes.**Pensamento estratégico** - Você terá a oportunidade de pensar grande, inovar e executar a estratégia de crescimento do segmento.**Presença executiva** - Seja uma pessoa influenciadora de Cx Os técnicos e de negócio de clientes, bem como interaja com executivos da AWS em todo o mundo.**Responsabilidades principais:**- Como membro-chave da equipe de liderança do Brasil, ser a liderança técnica de um segmento para garantir o sucesso na construção, migração e modernização de soluções dos clientes na plataforma AWS- Criar visão estratégica do futuro do segmento definindo um plano de ação para influenciar os principais clientes do Brasil- Pensar grande e inovar trazendo as tecnologias emergentes aplicadas na cadeia de valor de nossos clientes- Criar e Executar a estratégia de AI First no dia-a-dia da equipe trazendo produtividade e eficiência bem como na estratégia de cada cliente do segmento- Em parceria com a equipe de vendas, formular e executar a estratégia técnica para exceder as expectativas dos clientes e os objetivos da AWS através da adoção da plataforma- Contratar, integrar, treinar e desenvolver novos Arquitetos de Soluções- Orientar Arquitetos de Soluções nas habilidades necessárias para conduzir sessões de capacitação e transferir habilidades técnicas profundas para clientes- Capturar e compartilhar conhecimento de melhores práticas entre a comunidade de Arquitetos de Soluções da AWS e mercado- Orientar e motivar o desenvolvimento de whitepapers, apresentações e outros conteúdos de alto valor voltados para clientes- Atuar como canal de comunicação e ligação entre clientes, equipes de engenharia de serviços e suporte**Liderança e Gestão:**- Cultivar relacionamentos com líderes técnicos e de negócios dos clientes, representando a equipe em engajamentos estratégicos- Ser responsável pelas decisões técnicas da equipe e resolver deficiências de processos que impactam a experiência do cliente- Gerenciar equipe definindo objetivos e metas, simplificando requisitos técnicos e removendo blockers- Usar julgamento técnico para orientar a equipe em trade-offs de tecnologia e negócios- Definir estratégia de contratação e identificar futuros líderes na equipe- Construir cultura de inclusão, diversidade e equidade- Definir metas da equipe e manter cadência regular de inspeção do trabalho- Evangelizar nos Princípios de Liderança da AmazonAbout the teamSobre a equipeExperiências diversasA Amazon valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades desejáveis ​​listadas na descrição da vaga, encorajamos os candidatos a se inscreverem. Analisar e investigar todos os incidentes/acidentes ocorridos nas unidades de negócio da empresa propondo medidas de prevenção; Elaborar e implantar normas e procedimentos; monitorar e implementar  estatísticas e indicadores para controle dos programas de HSE (Safety & Health Environment)

Quais são os requisitos?
Curso Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho (registrado no DRT)
Experiência na área de segurança do trabalho
Habilidades numérica, escrita, comunicação, organização de gestão de tempo e demanda
Responsabilidades
Dentre as suas principais responsabilidade, você irá encontrar: 
1. Manter a empresa informada, através de parecer técnico (PGR) sobre os riscos existentes no ambiente de trabalho, bem como orientá-la sobre medidas de eliminação e neutralização;2. Manter os colaboradores informados sobre os riscos existentes em suas atividades, especificamente sobre as consideradas como insalubres ou perigosas, bem como as medidas alternativas de eliminação ou neutralização dos mesmos;3. Acompanhar diariamente a execução do trabalho, para verificar se os procedimentos de segurança e higiene do trabalho estão sendo seguidos e quando necessário adequá-los;4. Preparar e executar programas de prevenção de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais no ambiente de trabalho, avaliando seus resultados, bem como acompanhamento às mudanças que exigem atualização;5. Assessorar as atividades da CIPA, Comitê Ergonômico, Brigada de Incêndio e Brigada de Emergência;6. Manter os colaboradores informados sobre os riscos existentes em suas atividades, especificamente sobre as consideradas como insalubres ou perigosas;7. Acompanhar diariamente a execução do trabalho, para verificar se os procedimentos de segurança e higiene do trabalho estão sendo seguidos;8. Indicar, solicitar e inspecionar equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais, didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, dentro das qualidades e especificações técnicas e recomendadas;9. Participar de seminários, treinamentos, congressos e cursos visando o intercâmbio e o aperfeiçoamento profissional;10. Controlar e distribuir os uniformes e EPI´S em estoque;11. Elaborar os procedimentos e padronizações de todos os treinamentos constantes na matriz de treinamento de HSE;12. Realizar os reportes de HSE Corporativos e internos do site;13. Controlar e divulgar indicadores de HSE;14. Organizar o recebimento e despacho das notas fiscais dos Fornecedores, inclusive criação de RCCP e BOPP;15. Acompanhar e conferir as saídas de caçambas de reciclados do prestador de serviços;16. Criar as requisições de compra conforme necessidade da área;17. Colaborar no desenvolvimento de melhorias de HSE para o site;18. Realizar na Realização de Laudos de Segurança e implementação dos planos de ações (Laudo de Ergonomia, Elétrico, PPRA, PCMSO, etc);19. Administrar a compra e o abastecimento da Caixa de Primeiro Socorros;20. Criar as LPP´s na Operação;21. Participar das investigações de Incidentes/Acidentes juntamente com o técnico de HSE;22. Colaborar na implementação e revitalização dos Programas de HSE (Pirâmide, Educação Ambiental, Tolerância Zero, PDI, entre outros);23. Realizar solicitações de manutenção e fazer folow-up das ações;24. Administrar o Programa Pirâmide e criação de Scripts e Informativos de HSE;25. title: Gerente de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente em são paulo (RN)
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Could you be the full-time onsite Gerente de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente in Agua Branca, BR we’re looking for?
Your future role
"Take on a new challenge and apply your Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside inclusive and agile teammates.You'll lead impactful initiatives to ensure compliance with safety regulations, mitigate operational risks, and foster a strong safety culture in our São Paulo unit. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as operations, engineering, and corporate HSE), train and guide employees on safety and environmental practices, and much more."
We’ll look to you for:
Executing HSE activities in compliance with applicable legislation. ,
Identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational risks. ,
Conducting periodic inspections and coordinating corrective and preventive actions. ,
Monitoring operational activities to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards. ,
Training, guiding, and raising awareness among employees on safety, health, and environmental topics. ,
Implementing continuous improvement initiatives within the HSE management system. ,
Managing incident investigations, reporting, and performance indicators. ,
Ensuring compliance with legal requirements and corporate HSE policies. ,
Supporting the deployment of global Alstom standards and initiatives locally. ,
Driving collaboration across teams to enhance HSE performance and sustainability practices."
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Degree in Engineering with a postgraduate specialization in Safety Engineering. ,
Experience or understanding of Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) management in industrial settings. ,
Knowledge of local legal requirements and regulatory standards, including Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs). ,
Familiarity with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. ,
Advanced English communication skills (mandatory). ,
Strong leadership and team management skills. ,
Risk assessment and mitigation expertise. ,
Analytical mindset for monitoring performance indicators and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. ,
Training and coaching abilities to raise awareness and build a culture of safety. ,
Adaptability to work in fast-paced, diverse, and dynamic environments.
Things you’ll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues. ,
Work with a diverse and inclusive team committed to sustainable and impactful projects. ,
Progress towards becoming a key leader in fostering a culture of safety, health, and environmental excellence. ,
Utilise our innovative and dynamic working environment designed to promote continuous learning and resilience." ,
Contribute to innovative projects,
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries,
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning,
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Emerging market trader em brasília (RN)
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e. G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e. G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.

Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.

Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em cabo de santo agostinho (PE)
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Ugc content creator em cotia (MA)
description:
Location: Remote
Type: Freelance / Contract
Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app.
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video.
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

description: About Foundey Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting Saa S, AI, and tech startups. title: Investment banking intern em santos (PI)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Artificial intelligence engineer em rio branco (PI)
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”
Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms . Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.
Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services
Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence . Hands-on experience with:
LLM Agents
RAG pipelines
Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index
Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Prompt injection risks
Model supply chain security
Responsible AI controls
Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.
